name: Tempester 1.6.4.0-d (test)
description: 1.6.3.0 plus n°41 and n°43-n°46, a test image for the coordinator (no version digit of its own: the screens still show 1.6.3.0). n°41: in Pad to Note Mode « Mutes », a MIDI note mutes the sound of its pad note (A1-B16), whatever bank the panel shows; before, an A note muted the sound shown on that panel pad and a B note read past the 16 panel records. n°43: at power-on the Save folders of beats and projects are « Beats 1 » and « Projects 1 » instead of « Factory ». n°44: « Undo All Snds » (and « Undo Beat », same code) also restores the sound types, the play states (mute, solo, zero volume), the Voice Assign reservations and the selected pad's LEDs, as a single Undo Sound does. n°45: Reverse Off clears the live reverse of 16 Beats / 16 Mutes and the record reverse of all 16 beats, so no beat keeps recording reversed with the LED off. n°46: the Save/Load browser lists a folder in one directory pass (the same list as before; the factory loop when the pass cannot vouch for it). n°42 (slave Start) and n°47 (Copy Beat onto the current beat) are not made: see Docs/analyses/bugs-open-2026-11.md §10 and §3. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
